newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher in wake of bid activity.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher in wake of bid activity.

text.p: UK shares opened firmer on Thursday in the wake of renewed bid activity and after U.S. shares posted two straight days of profits.
The FTSE 100 index was up 5.1 points at 4,023.3 by 0841 GMT.
Traders said UK shares were likely to continue to make progress on the back of the surge in bid activity in the last couple of days.
"But I doubt if the gains will be very agressive," one said.
Bids and share buybacks in the market over the last two days have totalled about 2.5 billion stg.
